findings.problem: Each nested scientific-free actor starts a new session. Killing coordinator or actor process group cannot terminate their separately sessioned children; killing a nonleaf actor prevents its own child cleanup. Deadlines/alarms do not prove complete ownership/reaping. An observer error or outer interruption can leave an unaccounted descendant.
findings.prospective_remedy: Preserve V1 unexecuted. Contain nested actors in a declared group and use bounded cooperative direct-child termination plus exact nested cleanup acknowledgements. Emergency group termination remains UNKNOWN and must not claim successful complete reaping. No retries.

findings.problem: Raising signal handlers can interrupt spawn-to-registration or wait4-to-returncode bookkeeping. After wait4 has reaped but before returncode is set, cleanup may try to signal a historical PID/process group and wait a second time. A second TERM can also interrupt cleanup.
findings.prospective_remedy: Use cancellation flags at safe boundaries or explicit signal masking around process registration and reaping bookkeeping. Never signal an already reaped identity; account each direct child exactly once and bound cleanup under original whole deadline.

findings.problem: Full estimate uses outer SELF before receipt serialization plus a32MiB reserve. The source does not compare post-close outer SELF/frame clock to that reserve/caps before successful hard exit; the fixed whole alarm begins after imports/plan read and is disabled before terminal. Child frame durations exclude enclosing startup/exit/reap. A false estimate_under_fixed_256MiB does not change completed status or exit0.
findings.prospective_remedy: Keep raw finite observations distinguishable from accepted calibration. Bind a ROOT-measured actual outer startup-to-exit/reap clock and exact post-close frame; postvalidate unchanged60s/256MiB envelope. Any overrun or incomplete final record remains UNKNOWN with no retry.

findings.problem: Frame validation checks size/magic/role/PID/status but does not reject nonfinite or inconsistent duration/start/close values. PS parsing via zip permits missing RSS or ignored extra fields, and set equality permits duplicate PID rows; sampled PPID ancestry is not checked. Observer leaf=True is declared from command/source assumptions, not observed ancestry.
findings.prospective_remedy: Require finite nonnegative frame values with consistent clock differences, exact3-field PS rows, unique target PIDs, nonnegative RSS and expected PPID relationships. Make leaf scope explicit and preserve any uncertainty. Pin decoded bytes and exact source/runtime bindings before acceptance.

evidence_sufficiency.nominal_success_paths: Five fixed fresh workloads can supply finite allocation/RSS-unit and parent-versus-child terminal max-rollup observations, with two sequential equal-size children distinguishing maximum from accumulation. Separate PS wait4 records are an improvement over cumulative CHILDREN. Full raw artifacts and exact bounds still require independent saved-metadata interpretation after ROOT execution.
